headline.purpose: Page-level dashboard titles inside content cards.

title.purpose: Panel headers, modal titles, section titles.

body.purpose: Paragraph text, table cells, form fields, descriptions.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Default resting shadow under panels and content cards. Dark: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45).

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive card lift on hover. Dark: rgba(0,0,0,0.55).

shadows.name: sm
shadows.purpose: Tighter structural shadow for sub-panels and compact controls. Dark: rgba(0,0,0,0.6).

shadows.name: deep
shadows.purpose: Auth card, reader-mock components — maximum presence. Dark: rgba(0,0,0,0.8).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for nearly all transitions and hover lifts.

motion.name: tactile-press
motion.purpose: Every button and pressable control gets this same press feedback.

motion.name: theme-transition
motion.value: View Transitions API cross-fade (~280ms), falling back to a 260ms color transition on unsupported browsers

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action in a panel — royal-blue gradient with glass shimmer and tactile press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 42px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16); border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #5b7cee 0%, #3e66ea 50%, #2247cc 100%); color: #fff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.45), 0 10px 24px -4px rgba(35,78,225,0.42), 0 4px 10px -2px rgba(35,78,225,0.25); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), filter 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #234ef4; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cancel / navigate-back actions — translucent white glass with a top-sheen highlight.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; height: 42px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.9); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: #1e293b; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.95), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f1f5f9; color: #0f172a; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Status Pill — Success
components.description: Present/active/confirmed status. Dark mode uses a translucent tint, not a carried-over solid pastel.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-pill--success { background: #e3f6ea; color: #1a8a4c; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard labeled input — 12px radius, focus ring in brand blue.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 7px; color: #1e293b; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #234ef4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(35,78,244,0.12); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: The system's signature 28px-radius floating white surface with a navy-tinted ambient shadow.
components.html:
All Clients

12 of 48 schools shown.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 24px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -4px rgba(10,27,115,0.12); padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 6px; color: #0f172a; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; color: #334155; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: Pill-shaped nav link; active state is a solid royal-blue pill (a Solid Badge Exception — stays vivid in both themes).
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 999px; color: rgba(30,41,59,0.7); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #edf3fc; } .ds-nav-link--active { background: #234ef4; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Modal Hero Header
components.description: Signature modal header: tinted icon chip (solid-badge exception) + title + subtitle + close control.
components.html:
Add Client

Provisions a new school workspace with its own database.
components.css: .ds-modal-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-modal-hero { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; } .ds-modal-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: 0 0 44px; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eef2ff 0%, #dbe4ff 100%); color: #234ef4; border: 1px solid #dbe4ff; } .ds-modal-title { margin: 0; color: #071c44; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-modal-subtitle { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #64748b; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-modal-close { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; color: #64748b; cursor: pointer; } .ds-modal-close:hover { background: #f8faff; color: #223047; }

narrative.overview:
Adaptive Station's visual language is an administrative ledger with a confident, saturated signature: royal blue (#234ef4) is the identity color, but it appears with discipline — reserved for the shell's glass surfaces, primary actions, and active states, never spread thin across the page. Content lives on near-white, faintly blue-tinted surfaces with soft, deep-navy ambient shadows rather than pure black — every shadow in the system carries a trace of the brand color, so even the negative space feels branded.

The system runs a genuine two-mode life: a light "ledger" mode (white cards, blue accents, navy text) and a full dark mode that inverts every surface to a deep navy-black while keeping royal blue as the through-line — it just brightens rather than staying identical, so it reads correctly against a dark canvas instead of vibrating. The theme follows the visitor's OS preference until they make an explicit choice, then persists and syncs across tabs.

Every decision optimises for the daily operator. Status color appears only when the system has something to report; at rest, the interface is blue-and-white with confident navy text. The tactile press and glass-shimmer sheen on primary/danger buttons give the system its one indulgence: every click has physical weight.
keyCharacteristics: Royal-blue glass shell (sidebar + topbar) around white, blue-tinted content surfaces
Full parallel dark-mode token set — not an afterthought, a first-class second state
Status-only saturated color; the blue is identity, not decoration
Plus Jakarta Sans for display/headings, Inter for body and UI text, JetBrains Mono for codes/IDs
Glass shimmer + tactile press on every button; pill shapes for buttons, nav links, and badges
Ambient shadows tinted navy-blue, never neutral gray

rules.name: The Translucent Dark Rule
rules.body: Every status/pastel background that has to work in dark mode becomes a translucent rgba tint over the dark canvas, never a solid pastel carried over unchanged from light mode.

rules.name: The Manual Toggle Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is driven exclusively by the `.dark` class the user's explicit toggle applies to `<html>`, never by a parallel `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` block.

rules.name: The Solid Badge Exception
rules.body: A small set of tokens are deliberately fixed and do not flip in dark mode: solid navy/colored icon chips and badges paired with a hardcoded white foreground.

rules.name: The Two-Font Split Rule
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans is reserved for headings and hero/display moments; Inter carries everything else.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows in light mode are always navy-tinted rgba, never neutral black. Dark mode is the one deliberate exception — shadows there go to true black.

rules.name: The State-Responsive Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow intensity increases only in response to hover or modal/overlay state. A resting surface's shadow is ambient and unchanging.

rules.name: The No-Hard-Corner Rule
rules.body: No visible component uses border-radius: 0 or a value below 12px.

dos: Do use pf-btn-primary for one primary action per panel.

Do use the --as-* CSS custom properties for anything color-related; never hard-code a hex value that duplicates a token — and never redeclare the same property with a hardcoded literal after the token version in the same rule.
Do gate any dark-mode-specific style behind the .dark class, never @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark).
Do use border-radius: 999px for all buttons, nav links, badges, and pills.
Do keep saturated status color reserved for actual status communication.
Do tint shadows with brand navy in light mode; switch to true-black rgba only in dark mode.
donts: Don't use border-radius below 12px on any visible component.
Don't introduce a new accent color outside the royal-blue + status palette without an explicit design decision.
Don't carry a light-mode pastel status/chip background into dark mode unchanged.
Don't use the PrimaryButton/SecondaryButton Tailwind components from resources/js/Components/ in portal screens.
Don't place status color on decorative elements, headings, or link text.
Don't skip the pf-modal-header/ModalHero structure in modal forms.
